## Terms and Definitions to Remember

These terms are used throughout creator analytics reports. Use the search, category filter, and sort controls to quickly find the definition you need.

```{=html}
<div class="terms-table-tool" data-terms-table data-source="../../assets/data/creator_report_terms_definitions.json">
  <div class="terms-table-controls">
    <div class="terms-control">
      <label for="terms-search">Search terms</label>
      <input id="terms-search" type="search" placeholder="Search terms or definitions..." autocomplete="off">
    </div>
    <div class="terms-control">
      <label for="terms-category">Primary category</label>
      <select id="terms-category">
        <option value="">All categories</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="terms-control">
      <label for="terms-sort">Sort by</label>
      <select id="terms-sort">
        <option value="term-asc">Term A-Z</option>
        <option value="term-desc">Term Z-A</option>
        <option value="category-asc">Primary category A-Z</option>
        <option value="category-desc">Primary category Z-A</option>
        <option value="definition-asc">Definition A-Z</option>
        <option value="definition-desc">Definition Z-A</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="terms-table-wrap">
    <table class="terms-table">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col"><button type="button" data-sort-key="term">Term <span class="terms-sort-state">Sort</span></button></th>
          <th scope="col"><button type="button" data-sort-key="definition">Definition <span class="terms-sort-state">Sort</span></button></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <p class="terms-table-status" aria-live="polite">Loading terms...</p>
</div>

<style>
  .terms-table-tool {
    margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
  }

  .terms-table-controls {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(16rem, 1fr) minmax(12rem, 16rem) minmax(12rem, 16rem);
    gap: 0.75rem;
    align-items: end;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .terms-control label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    color: var(--sda-ink);
    font-family: var(--sda-sans);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .terms-control input,
  .terms-control select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--sda-line);
    background: var(--sda-paper);
    color: var(--sda-ink);
    font-family: var(--sda-sans);
  }

  .terms-table-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--sda-line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sda-line);
  }

  .terms-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 760px;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    table-layout: fixed;
  }

  .terms-table colgroup col:first-child {
    width: 16rem !important;
  }

  .terms-table colgroup col:nth-child(2) {
    width: auto !important;
  }

  .terms-table th,
  .terms-table td {
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sda-soft-line);
    vertical-align: top;
  }

  .terms-table th {
    background: var(--sda-paper);
  }

  .terms-table th:first-child,
  .terms-table td:first-child {
    width: 16rem;
  }

  .terms-table th:nth-child(2),
  .terms-table td:nth-child(2) {
    width: auto;
  }

  .terms-table th button {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--sda-ink);
    font-family: var(--sda-sans);
    font-weight: 900;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .terms-table td:first-child {
    color: var(--sda-ink);
    font-family: var(--sda-sans);
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .terms-aliases {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
    color: var(--sda-muted);
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .terms-sort-state {
    color: var(--sda-muted);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .terms-table tbody tr:hover {
    background: var(--sda-accent-soft);
  }

  .terms-table-status {
    margin-top: 0.6rem;
    color: var(--sda-muted);
    font-family: var(--sda-sans);
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .terms-table-controls {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
  }
</style>

<script>
  (() => {
    const tableTool = document.querySelector("[data-terms-table]");
    if (!tableTool) return;

    const search = tableTool.querySelector("#terms-search");
    const categoryFilter = tableTool.querySelector("#terms-category");
    const sortSelect = tableTool.querySelector("#terms-sort");
    const table = tableTool.querySelector(".terms-table");
    const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");
    const status = tableTool.querySelector(".terms-table-status");
    const columnIndex = {
      term: 0,
      definition: 1
    };
    let rows = [];
    let activeSortKey = "term";
    let activeSortDirection = "asc";

    const getSortText = (row, key) => {
      if (key === "category") return row.dataset.category || "";
      return row.children[columnIndex[key]].textContent.trim();
    };

    const makeCell = (text, className = "") => {
      const cell = document.createElement("td");
      if (className) cell.className = className;
      cell.textContent = text;
      return cell;
    };

    const updateStatus = () => {
      const visibleCount = rows.filter((row) => !row.hidden).length;
      status.textContent = `Showing ${visibleCount} ${visibleCount === 1 ? "term" : "terms"}.`;
    };

    const flattenTerms = (data) => {
      return (data.sections || []).flatMap((section) => {
        return (section.terms || []).map((term) => ({
          category: section.section,
          term: term.term,
          aliases: term.aliases || [],
          definition: term.definition,
          id: term.id
        }));
      });
    };

    const populateCategories = () => {
      Array.from(new Set(rows.map((row) => row.dataset.category)))
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
        .forEach((category) => {
          const option = document.createElement("option");
          option.value = category;
          option.textContent = category;
          categoryFilter.appendChild(option);
        });
    };

    const renderRows = (terms) => {
      tbody.innerHTML = "";
      rows = terms.map((item) => {
        const row = document.createElement("tr");
        row.dataset.category = item.category;
        row.dataset.searchText = [item.category, item.term, item.aliases.join(" "), item.definition].join(" ").toLowerCase();
        if (item.id) row.id = item.id;

        const termCell = makeCell("");
        termCell.textContent = item.term;
        if (item.aliases.length) {
          const aliases = document.createElement("span");
          aliases.className = "terms-aliases";
          aliases.textContent = `Also: ${item.aliases.join(", ")}`;
          termCell.appendChild(aliases);
        }
        row.appendChild(termCell);
        row.appendChild(makeCell(item.definition));
        tbody.appendChild(row);
        return row;
      });
    };

    const applyFilters = () => {
      const query = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      const selectedCategory = categoryFilter.value;

      rows.forEach((row) => {
        const matchesSearch = !query || row.dataset.searchText.includes(query);
        const matchesCategory = !selectedCategory || row.dataset.category === selectedCategory;
        row.hidden = !(matchesSearch && matchesCategory);
      });

      updateStatus();
    };

    const updateHeaderLabels = () => {
      table.querySelectorAll("[data-sort-key]").forEach((button) => {
        const state = button.querySelector(".terms-sort-state");
        if (button.dataset.sortKey !== activeSortKey) {
          state.textContent = "Sort";
          return;
        }
        state.textContent = activeSortDirection === "asc" ? "Asc" : "Desc";
      });
    };

    const sortRows = (key, direction = activeSortDirection) => {
      activeSortKey = key;
      activeSortDirection = direction;

      rows
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const left = getSortText(a, key);
          const right = getSortText(b, key);
          const result = left.localeCompare(right, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" });
          return activeSortDirection === "asc" ? result : -result;
        })
        .forEach((row) => tbody.appendChild(row));

      sortSelect.value = `${activeSortKey}-${activeSortDirection}`;
      updateHeaderLabels();
      applyFilters();
    };

    const loadTerms = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(tableTool.dataset.source);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
        const data = await response.json();
        const terms = flattenTerms(data);

        renderRows(terms);
        populateCategories();
        sortRows("term", "asc");
      } catch (error) {
        status.textContent = "Terms could not be loaded.";
        console.error("Unable to load creator report terms definitions:", error);
      }
    };

    table.querySelectorAll("[data-sort-key]").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const key = button.dataset.sortKey;
        const nextDirection = activeSortKey === key && activeSortDirection === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
        sortRows(key, nextDirection);
      });
    });

    sortSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
      const [key, direction] = sortSelect.value.split("-");
      sortRows(key, direction);
    });
    search.addEventListener("input", applyFilters);
    categoryFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);

    loadTerms();
  })();
</script>
```
